decisions.reason: The startup accelerator lies outside the firm's machinery and recycling engineering knowledge base and gives it little related knowledge to interpret results or improve the offer, so after the withdrawal of Product B, focusing resources on core recycling plants is the likely next step.

The infectious waste decontamination plant builds on the modular WASTX platform and the ERMAFA cooperation, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from early installations and refine it as a flagship.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a close extension of the core decentralized recycling machinery and doubles as a pretreatment stage, so the firm's in-house R&D can readily absorb customer feedback and improve it.
